collections.selectionRule: Manual title screen for explicit condensed-matter quantum states, excitonic/correlated/magnetic/topological materials, superconducting conductors, and phonon/qubit-material sensing. General quantum algorithms, field theory, nuclear/fusion theory, workshops, generic semiconductor/energy materials and company sensors without a clear quantum-materials object are excluded.

limitations: Complete within the five selected BES targeted-call rosters, not all federal or DOE awards. Roster phases do not provide expenditure totals.
2018/2019/2021 QIS call records include the complete named portfolio; broader QIS entries are explicitly distinguished from direct quantum-materials research.
From FY2022 BES QIS support is integrated into annual core calls and Early Career competitions; no comprehensive single quantum-materials grant roster or reproducible full PAMS export was obtained.
2000–2007 and many later individual awards remain uncovered. Historical examples begin in 2008. Absence means not collected, not no funding.
The 2026 EFRC $352m announcement is a solicitation and is excluded from award records. No recipient roster was located for that call as of 4 November 2026.
2026 mixed selections were manually screened by project title; 13 of 217 source rows included. No dollar amount inferred from the $320m program envelope.
Host links identify leads or documented collaborators, not institutional receipts. No consortium total is assigned to either lead or partner.
2014 BES portfolio support snapshots are retained separately and excluded from phase totals because annual support can overlap multi-year awards.

PAMS was identified as the official public award search but a full export was not obtained. SBIR/STTR, ARPA-E, isotope supply projects, all core BES grants, and unclassified national-lab funding work proposals are not exhaustively covered.
